get-in-touch.title: Get in touch
get-in-touch.paragraph-1: Reinforced with its experience in cataloging and access resources, PASS-TECH gives its expertise to building actors to make easier the connection and offer a unique space to access the mutliple service offer of the market.
get-in-touch.paragraph-2: On our platform you will be able to :
get-in-touch.list-1: Search and access to the services you need
get-in-touch.list-2: Offer your different services and their access methods
get-in-touch.paragraph-3: This platform aims to you if :
get-in-touch.list-3: You offer a service, a training, a tool or a platform highlight your skills
get-in-touch.list-4: You look for a service, a training, a tool or a platform for your own need.
get-in-touch.paragraph-4: Came and discover an other way to generalize access to all the available services.

free-access.title: Free access
free-access.paragraph-1: Sign up is totally FREE. Whether you are looking for services or offering services. In order to access to these advanced features, we collaborate with service providers to hilight the services they offer.
free-access.paragraph-2: If you offer a service, your company will be able to offer a Unique Authentication system to link your platform to this catalog.In this way, the authenticated user on the catalog will be in a fluid experience to navigate between every services wich he subscribes : from point cloud survey, to BIM process digital modeling, to their viewing in a collaborative BIM viewer.

contribution.title: Contributions
contribution.paragraph: Creation and publication of services are fully free. Only advanced connection options are treated case by case depends on the complexity of implementation and available funding sources. If vou want to contribute to this service and access generalization effort, feel free to make a contribution at this link :

pass-tech.paragraph-1: Operating in the cultural, educational and construction sectors for several years, PASS-TECH is a preferred partner of professionals, companies and institutions seeking to deploy solutions and developments made, among other things, from “Open Source” components. . PASS-TECH has developed expertise in document computing, information systems and decentralized data management.
pass-tech.li-1: offer an technological infrastructure able to host your SaaS or Paas applications.
pass-tech.li-2: offer a catalogue of modular resources complying with LOM, LOMFR et SCOLOMFR norms, and compatible with GAR project.
pass-tech.li-3: offer a colaborative Digital Twins platform intagrating a GLTF and IFS viewer that permit to view 3D modelling, and associated warm and cold data.

road-map.title: Road map
